chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub, from a number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Hanan, from Zurarah, from Abu Ja'far عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about a man who performs tawaf without wudu (ablution): is that tawaf counted? He said: No.

key_terms.أَيَعْتَدُّ: is it regarded as valid or counted
key_terms.الطَّوَافِ: the ritual circumambulation around the Ka'bah
key_terms.لَا: a negation indicating invalidity in this legal context
key_terms.يَطُوفُ: he performs tawaf, circling the Ka'bah as a rite of worship

ai.seo_question: Is tawaf valid without wudu (ablution) according to Imam Abu Ja'far عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states that tawaf performed without wudu (ablution) is not considered valid. It is a legal ruling concerning ritual purity in the acts of hajj and worship.
